messages:
lina: Hi — first day yay! Trying to finish MDM enrollment but get "Enrollment failed (403)" after clicking Continue on the Company Portal. On corporate Wi‑Fi with the proxy. Anyone seen this?

jamie-it: Welcome! :wave: Can you paste the exact error screen? Is this on macOS Ventura 13.x?

lina: Screenshot attached (not in thread). It's Ventura 13.4.7. The dialog says "Enrollment failed: Server rejected request (403)". I can browse the web fine, but internal sites are proxied. Command output I ran:
```
$ sudo profiles status -type enrollment
No device management profiles installed.
```

marcos-devops: Sounds like the proxy is stripping or replacing the TLS cert for the MDM endpoint. Our MDM uses client-managed cert validation. Try temporarily connecting to your phone hotspot (no proxy) and enroll. If that works, we need to add proxy bypass for mdm.redwood-inf.internal.

lina: Trying hotspot now. One sec...

(later) lina: Confirmed — enrollment worked over phone hotspot. So it's definitely the proxy.

jamie-it: Ok. Two options:
1) We can add a proxy bypass for mdm.redwood-inf.internal on the corp network (I can request it with infra), or
2) We can have you enroll using a USB tether/hotspot and I'll create the device record and push the policy so future updates succeed behind proxy.

emma-people-ops: If you need a temporary hotspot device, we have one at People Ops desk — ping me and we'll hand it over quickly.

lina: Thanks! I'll use the hotspot to finish enrollment and ping @jamie-it when done.

mdm-bot: Device enrolled: lina-mbp (serial: C02QXXXXFHD). Assigned profile: Redwood-Laptop-Baseline.

jamie-it: Got it. I see the device now. I'll request the proxy bypass for mdm.redwood-inf.internal and also add a rule to allow our MDM cert through the proxy. ETA 24–48h.

lina: All good for now. Appreciate the quick help! :smile:

marcos-devops: Logged infra ticket #INFRA-4821 to add bypass and cert passthrough. Linking it here: https://go.redwood.internal/infra/INFRA-4821

lina: Thanks — marking this resolved for my onboarding checklist.
